email.subject1: signal to action latency at Rebuy
email.body1:
Nicole, saw Rebuy brands drove $1.7B in GMV over BFCM and expanded Rebuy Monetize.

At that scale, the real revenue bottleneck is signal-to-action latency, how fast a buying signal turns into a booked meeting. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every touch auto-logged.

I built a personalized signal play for Rebuy off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nicole, quick follow-up for Rebuy.

Most RevOps leaders find their measurable lift sits in the gap between signal captured and rep action, not in adding more activity. That latency quietly caps pipeline no matter how clean the data is.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound motion, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. I'll bring specifics for Rebuy.
email.body3:
Nicole, last bit of proof for Rebuy.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rebuy's reply rate likely compares to other ecommerce-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nicole, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Coming off a record BFCM, I know the RevOps stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Rebuy either way.
